original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. type_lint reports no layerDiscipline finding for pool_preimageOf_consistent. The statement of pool_preimageOf_consistent does not change.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. At integrated, scripts/type_lint.lean prints a layerDiscipline finding with declaration pool_preimageOf_consistent.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run `lake build ArmadaLean ArmadaLean.Lint.TypeDoctrine` and `lake env lean scripts/type_lint.lean` through /home/rix/bin/lean-run; read the JSON lines by their linter and declaration fields.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. No spec statement changes; scripts/check.sh --json reports signatures_ok true. scripts/check.sh --json keeps every _ok field true against scripts/gate-baseline.json; a full run takes up to 1500 seconds. A bare `lake clean` is never run.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) pool_preimageOf_consistent
restatement: Fix the layerDiscipline linter false-positive for the declaration pool_preimageOf_consistent, without changing the statement of pool_preimageOf_consistent or any other spec statement. After the fix, running the type_lint.lean script against the built project must no longer emit a layerDiscipline finding naming pool_preimageOf_consistent, while scripts/check.sh --json must continue to report signatures_ok true and keep every _ok field true relative to scripts/gate-baseline.json, within the existing time budget, and without ever invoking a bare lake clean.

restatement_clauses.text: After the fix, lake env lean scripts/type_lint.lean must report no layerDiscipline finding whose declaration field is pool_preimageOf_consistent.
The statement of pool_preimageOf_consistent must not change.
No other spec statement changes as part of this fix.
scripts/check.sh --json must keep every _ok field true against scripts/gate-baseline.json.
A full run of the acceptance checks must complete within 1500 seconds.
A bare lake clean must never be run as part of reproducing or verifying this fix.

goal: Make a code-quality checker stop flagging a particular proof as breaking a layering rule, without actually changing what that proof claims, and without breaking any other checks that are already passing.
acceptance_criteria: After running the project's type linter, there should be no reported layerDiscipline issue that points at the declaration pool_preimageOf_consistent.

Someone searches the codebase for the theorem named pool_preimageOf_consistent and prints out its exact statement (the part before ':= by' or the proof body). The check confirms the statement text still matches the known, approved wording.

After the fix is applied, everything in AGENTS.md outside the 'Acceptance' section (the rules about lake clean, forbidden commands, Lean style, and commit practice) must read exactly the same as before — only the Acceptance section itself may have changed.
Running the project's check script in JSON mode shows that the signatures check passed (signatures_ok is true).
Running the project's check script with --json should show that every field ending in _ok is true, matching or beating the baseline recorded in scripts/gate-baseline.json.
Running the full set of acceptance checks finishes within 25 minutes (1500 seconds) of being started.
Checks that the project's build/verification scripts never call 'lake clean' by itself, since doing so would wipe out the shared Mathlib build used by every worktree.
